launch_status: Root intends launch; actual cloud state not yet confirmed in this receipt.
evidence_available_at_decision: Both matched seed 11 arms completed 51,200-step development evaluations; 102,400-step evaluations still pending.

scope.execution: Six serial matched fresh trials initialized from the same filtered supervised BAL foundation.

rationale: Projected PPO preserves 4/4 hanging and 4/4 upright final 5 s holds with no faults.
Mean hanging capture improves 7.08 to 5.35 s; minimum final dwell improves 16.81 to 19.84 s.
This concrete development improvement satisfies the postbaseline addendum; the long experiment tests replication across seeds and whether improvement lasts.
The initial checkpoint remains eligible; no automatic new checkpoint promotion or hardware qualification.
tradeoffs: All 4 hanging cases still use rail braking and reach approximately 0.29408 m.
PPO braking control steps decrease 1,604 to 945 across four 25 s cases, but rail dependence persists.
PPO upright worst cart excursion worsens 72.9 to 88.2 mm and final-window cart RMS worsens 45.2 to 53.2 mm.
Retained midpoint improves mean capture only 7.08 to 6.93 s and largely preserves centering.
One optimizer seed and four development poses; nominal model only; hardware swing-up remains untested.
The separate ±1 degree long-horizon bias diagnostic showed strict centering hold failure even with bounded pole motion; this robustness limitation is not resolved.
